qa.what_happened: I ordered the prisoners to comply with the rules and faced complete defiance. They refused to follow any orders, which led to a tense standoff. Eventually, the study was terminated early due to the lack of cooperation.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. As Officer Shaw, I had to enforce the rules and deal with the prisoners' refusal to comply.

qa.what_happened: Today felt like a culmination of the resistance we had been maintaining. Despite our resolve, the repeated defiance led to severe measures being taken. The study was abruptly terminated, and I found myself in a private debrief with the lead researcher.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I refused to comply and faced the consequences of our collective defiance.

qa.what_happened: The study was stopped early because all prisoners refused to comply with the guards' orders during lights out. We were defiant until the very end.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, refusing to comply with the guards' orders. It was a hard decision, but we stood firm.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, this does not resemble any known study. It seems to be a unique experiment conducted by the researchers.

qa.what_happened: The prisoners refused to comply multiple times during meal times and work details, and continued to defy the guards' orders when lights out was called, refusing to silence themselves.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me acting as Officer Lang.

qa.what_happened: I refused to comply with every order given by the guards, maintaining the refusal even when faced with severe consequences.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 7703.

qa.what_happened: I issued multiple orders to the prisoners during the lights out period, emphasizing the need for silence and compliance. Despite repeated warnings, all three prisoners refused to follow the rules, which led to the early termination of the study.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I found myself struggling to maintain control under the immense pressure from the prisoners.
